company_name: Huangshan Juxin New Material Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Huangshan Juxin New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in high-performance polyimide resins that are widely used in the semiconductor industry for various applications.
summary: Huangshan Juxin New Material Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of high-performance polyimide materials, offering customized solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their products are utilized in applications requiring high temperature resistance, electrical insulation, and mechanical strength, making them suitable for various semiconductor components.

Customized polyimide solutions for high-temperature environments
